title: No Undo after an alarm is acknowledged: the row says who saw it and when
why: CLAUDE.md (Jason, 2026-11-23): a record someone entered is edited, never undone; Undo only for an action that did something. Acknowledge records who saw a trip, so its Undo goes: on the board's rows, on a module's card, and in Pulse, where Reopen no longer takes the acknowledgement back. In the Work queue as task #2, "No Undo on alarm acknowledgements" (Jason's scope doc: done when there's no Undo on any alarm; rule #1314).

changes.what: An acknowledged trip's row shows "Seen by <name>, <time>" as its state line, with no Undo; it stays open while it holds, Check and start again still there
A module's card: Acknowledge on a trip, then "1 trip (seen by <name>)" with no Undo Acknowledge
Pulse: Reopen on an alarm's case reopens the case and keeps the acknowledgement (who and when)
FAQ: the Alarms entry says so
